request.description:
This operation is deprecated and will be removed in a future version. We do not recommend using it in production applications. Retrieves a list of the BuildingConnected projects a user has access to. By default, only projects owned by the requesting user’s company are provided. This endpoint will additionally return projects owned by other companies when the includeExternal parameter is provided. A BuildingConnected project represents a request for proposals, typically representing a single phase of bidding. It can be linked to a Forma project, but it’s technically separate, and may be related to the Forma project on a many-to-one basis. For example: a project may go through three phases of bidding before proceeding to site construction; this process could potentially be represented by three BuildingConnected projects and one Forma project. A project is a top-level container for all scopes of work in a phase of bidding. Each individual scope of work is presented as a bid package. Each bid package has bidders (represented by invites to bid), and each bidder creates bids in response to an invite.

---

**Operation ID:** `buildingconnected-projects-GET`
**Endpoint:** `GET /construction/buildingconnected/v2/projects`
**Authentication:** User context required
**Required OAuth Scopes:** `data:read`
**Data Format:** JSON

**Headers**
- `Authorization` *(required)* — Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is a three-legged access token obtained via an Authorization Code flow or a Secure Service Account (SSA) flow. The SSA flow is designed for headless server-to-server operations. While it functions like a two-legged flow (no user interaction), it is classified…

**Query String Parameters**
- `cursorState` (string) — An opaque cursor token that identifies where the next page of paginated results should start. It’s returned in each paginated response so that it can be provided in the next request to continue paginated results. If a paginated response contains no cursorState value, there are no further pages to return. Omit this parameter to initiate a paginated request or to restart pagination.
- `limit` (int) — The maximum number of records that the endpoint may return per page. Note that a returned page may contain fewer records than the limit under either of these conditions: - There are fewer records found than the limit value. - The last page of a set is returned. Default value: 100
- `filter[updatedAt]` (string) — The required range of dates and times during which the last update must have been made to the objects returned in the response, in ISO 8601 format. A single date and time takes this format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ, A date and time range takes this format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ..YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ. Range queries can be closed or open in either direction: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ.. or ..YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ.
- `filter[owningOfficeId]` (array: string) **(accepts a comma-separated list of values)** — A comma separated list of office IDs that own the relevant objects. The owningOfficeId must belong to the requesting user’s company.
- `filter[userId]` (string) — The unique BuildingConnected user ID for which to query projects. Only projects this user has access to will be provided. Results will only include projects for which the requesting user also has access. The userId must belong to the requesting user’s company.
- `filter[currentAccLinkedProjectId]` (string) — The ID of a Forma project with which the objects returned in the response are associated with BuildingConnected projects that are linked to this Forma Project.
- `searchText` (string) — Search for projects whose name or number matches this text. It is case-insensitive and only matches from the start of a word.
- `includeClosed` (boolean) — Whether to include closed projects in the response. Possible values: - true: Closed projects are included. - false: (Default) Closed projects are not included.
- `includeExternal` (boolean) — Whether to include projects from external companies in the response. Possible values: - true: External projects are included. - false: (Default) External projects are not included. Note that this filter can be used only with filter[userId] or filter[currentAccLinkedProjectId].

**HTTP Status Codes:** `200`, `400`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `429`, `500`

request.description:
Retrieves a list of risk flags for subcontractor companies. Use this endpoint to get flags that general contractors have created to capture risks or concerns related to qualifications, bids, or ongoing projects. You can filter results by company, type, priority, state, or date range. You can also include the state history of each flag.

---

**Operation ID:** `tradetapp-flags-GET`
**Endpoint:** `GET /construction/tradetapp/v2/flags`
**Authentication:** User context required
**Required OAuth Scopes:** `data:read`
**Data Format:** JSON

**Headers**
- `Authorization` *(required)* — Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is a three-legged access token obtained via an Authorization Code flow.
- `general-contractor-company-id` *(optional)* — This header is required only for users who belong to a parent enterprise company in TradeTapp. It specifies the BuildingConnected company ID of the child general contractor company for which the request should be performed. Otherwise, it is impossible to know for which child general contractor…

**Query String Parameters**
- `cursorState` (string) — An opaque cursor token that identifies where the next page of paginated results should start. It is returned in each paginated response so that it can be provided in the next request to continue paginated results. If a paginated response contains no cursorState value, there are no further pages to return. Omit this parameter to initiate a paginated request or to restart pagination.
- `limit` (int) — The maximum number of records to return per page. A page may contain fewer records than the limit if fewer records exist or if the last page is returned. Default: 20. Maximum: 100.
- `sort` (string) — A comma-separated list of fields to sort by. Supported fields are name, type, priority, eventDate, createdAt, and updatedAt. Sorting by priority in descending order returns results in the order HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW. Sorting by type follows alphabetical order. For example: eventDate desc,name asc.
- `include` (string) — A sub-resource to include in the response. Currently only stateHistory is supported. If include=stateHistory is provided, the response includes a history of the flag states. If not included, the state history is omitted.
- `filter[company.id]` (string) — The subcontractor company’s BC ID.
- `filter[type]` (enum:string) — The type of flag or proposed flag. Possible values: GENERAL, INSURANCE, SAFETY, FINANCIAL, PROJECT, COMMUNICATION, OTHER
- `filter[priority]` (enum:string) — The priority of the flag or proposed flag. Possible values: HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
- `filter[eventDate]` (string) — The required date or date range of the event for which the flag or proposed flag was created. Use the ISO 8601 date format YYYY-MM-DD for a single date, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD for a range. Ranges can be open-ended: YYYY-MM-DD.. or ..YYYY-MM-DD. The lower bound is inclusive; the upper bound is exclusive.
- `filter[triggerAlert]` (boolean) — Indicates whether the flag should trigger an alert modal when the subcontractor profile is opened in TradeTapp. true — The flag triggers an alert. false — The flag does not trigger an alert.
- `filter[state]` (enum:string) — The state of the flag. Possible values: ACTIVE, RESOLVED
- `filter[company.uniqueId]` (string) — The general contractor’s internal unique reference ID for the subcontractor company. This ID may be populated from an external system such as an ERP or CRM, or entered manually in TradeTapp.
- `filter[company.taxId]` (string) — The tax ID of the subcontractor’s company. If hyphens are present in the tax ID, they are removed before filtering because tax IDs are stored without hyphens.
- `filter[company.taxType]` (enum:string) — The tax ID type of the subcontractor’s company. Use this field with filter[company.taxId] to uniquely identify the company. Possible values: US_FEIN, US_SSN, CAN_BN, OTHER
- `filter[createdAt]` (string) — The date and time range when the flags were originally created. Use the ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ for a single timestamp, or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ..YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ for a range. Ranges can be open-ended: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ.. or ..YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ. The lower bound is inclusive; the upper bound is exclusive.
- `filter[updatedAt]` (string) — The date and time range when the flags were last updated. Use the ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ for a single timestamp, or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ..YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ for a range. Ranges can be open-ended: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ.. or ..YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ. The lower bound is inclusive; the upper bound is exclusive.

**Endpoint:** `PATCH /construction/tradetapp/v2/flags/{flagId}`
**Authentication:** User context required
**Required OAuth Scopes:** `data:write`
**Data Format:** JSON

**Headers**
- `Authorization` *(required)* — Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is a three-legged access token obtained via an Authorization Code flow.
- `general-contractor-company-id` *(optional)* — This header is required only for users who belong to a parent enterprise company in TradeTapp. It specifies the BuildingConnected company ID of the child general contractor company for which the request should be performed. Otherwise, it is impossible to know for which child general contractor…
- `Content-Type` *(required)* — Must be application/json

**Path Parameters**
- `flagId` (int) — The unique identifier of the flag.

**Request Body**
- `eventDate` (string) — The date of the event for which this flag was created in ISO-8601 full-date format (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `name` (string) — The name of the flag. Max length: 100
- `priority` (enum:string) — The priority of the flag Possible values: HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
- `summary` (string) — The summary note for this flag. Max length: 500
- `type` (enum:string) — The type of the flag. Possible values: GENERAL, INSURANCE, SAFETY, FINANCIAL, PROJECT, COMMUNICATION, OTHER
- `triggerAlert` (boolean) — Indicates whether this flag should display an alert when opening the invite associated with this flag in the TradeTapp app.
- `state` (object) — The properties to update the state of a flag.
  - `value` (enum:string) *(required)* — The state of the flag. Possible values: RESOLVED, ACTIVE
  - `summary` (string) — The summary of the state of the flag. If the flag is in the “resolved” state, then this is the resolution summary. If the flag is in the “active” state after being moved from “resolved”, then this is the re-opened summary. Max length: 500

**HTTP Status Codes:** `200`, `400`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `409`, `429`, `500`
